artifact.name: Workbench Continuity
artifact.description: Carry project source, state and build tools between chats; privately sign returned APKs on Android.

intent.purpose: Keep actual working projects and their next actions portable across chats, with integrated first-time build runtime setup.
success_criteria: Source and notes survive work-packet round trips.
Both emitted runtime carrier routes reconstruct verified tools and build the current owned example.
Signing keys remain outside project and AI packets.

environment: Windows PowerShell for one-time runtime collection
Linux x86_64, Python 3.10+, JDK 17+ for builds
operation.network_notes: First-time setup downloads pinned official SDK archives after the person chooses to accept terms. Workbench UI and Android app operate locally without network permission.

dependencies.name: Per-person API 35 / Build Tools 35.0.0 runtime
dependencies.requirement: Generated with included setup or existing public ABC runtime
dependencies.purpose: Carry build tools to supported chat execution hosts

dependencies.name: Public apksig Maven dependency
dependencies.purpose: Private native Android APK signing and verification

source_of_truth.role: Project engine, UI and public runtime adapter
Pinned public MIT setup and runner

generated_outputs.role: Public HTML and included setup ZIP

allowed_actions: Inspect, edit, build and publish owned public code.
must: Preserve current project and signing behavior.
Keep signing credentials and generated SDK runtimes private.
Record fresh proof separately from historical tests.
must_not: Include owner-private carriers or fixture corpus in public packages.
Claim a device or external AI test that was not observed.

data_handling.notes: Public source contains no SDK runtime or owner signing key.

setup: Read README_FIRST.txt. Run SETUP_WORKBENCH.bat on Windows if you choose to generate tools.
edit: Continue existing source. Preserve native signing and original project engine.
build: Follow BUILD.md; retain release key separately outside the repository.
verify: Run documented checks and inspect VERIFICATION.md.
release: Publish prepared public source and release assets.
recovery: Open an exported project work packet and load the retained runtime ZIP.

checks.description: SDK-free packet and signing UI contracts
checks.expected: Documented Node and Python tests pass

checks.description: Actual emitted PDF/ZIP tools and current source recover and compile
checks.expected: Real-runtime roundtrip report passes for Claude and Grok
Separately observe project intake, both exports and private signer on Android

authority.change_policy: Make only changes needed for the authorized public version; preserve working behavior.

safe_first_actions: Inspect public source and verification scope.
Continue existing behavior; keep private material separate.
known_limitations: No fresh physical-device or external AI chat run in this release preparation.
Receiving chats need code execution and the documented host profile.

review.notes: Public preparation; host and emitted-route checks passed. Physical-device observations remain separate.
